text:
Aisha: quick weekly pulse for Helio Labs — seeing a weird combo: WoW token drop, QoQ up, midday latency bump. Pls read.

Aisha: key snapshot:
```
tokens 480k -> 422k (-12%)
p50 110ms -> 205ms (+86%)
5xx 0.1% -> 0.9% (+0.8pp)
spend $17.9k -> $19.6k (+9.4%)
```

Aisha: latency concentrated 10:00-13:00 PST yesterday; batch sizes and seq lengths trended up. @Miguel can you triage?

Miguel: on it. pulling per-request traces and batch windows now. early signal = long-seq tail from a small set of keys. scheduling 10m sync.

Nate: uploaded quick CSV to our secure gist (placeholder). ~70% tokens from 2-3 client keys; one client shifted to >1k seqs at spike time.

Miguel: hypothesis: workload shift -> KV miss + fallback to quant variant -> p50 increase. will check selector logs and node capacity.

Priya: propose a 20m enablement session on prompt windowing + truncation + batching tips for Helio devs. I can prep one-pager.

Jian: renewal POV: health score down 76 -> 63. mark as "watch"; escalate if <=60 next check. not urgent yet.

deploy-bot: Anomaly AD-4421: model-variant fallbacks correlated with increased latency 2024-09-12T10:05Z-12:55Z.

Aisha: agreed actions: Miguel+Nate deep-dive + CSV by EOD; Priya schedule enablement Tue; Jian flag renewal watch. I'll post summary in #customer-success tomorrow. :thumbsup:
